P.flaw: Held-until label is lighter grey and the layout leaves a large dead gap above the button.

Q.flaw: Grey Held-until text on grey background likely misses 7:1 and half the screen is empty.

ui-1.why_top: P has a clear, high-contrast hierarchy with the huge order number, bold key facts and a full-width button, all in a clean layout.

P.flaw: Big empty gaps and a bare text snooze make the layout loose and the controls feel unanchored.

Q.flaw: Cancel is a bland grey button of similar weight to the text, with empty voids between sections.

R.flaw: Stop timeline is unevenly spaced and the snooze button is a filled box close to cancel.

S.flaw: Cancel sits close beside snooze, so the gap between the two controls is only a little above the minimum.

ui-2.why_top: S gives a dominant amber 7 min, a clearly flagged but outlined cancel at the top, a quieter outlined snooze, and a compact progress card with all data.
